correctness.evidence: Independent exhaustive FWHT enumeration reproduced all 65,536 n=4 joint cells and all 256 five-variable cyclic-RSBF joint cells, with Parseval checked for every function and the mask-30 witness reconstructed exactly.

originality.evidence: Classical marginals and the eight five-variable 1-resilient nonlinearity-12 RSBFs are prior (Stănică–Maitra 2008). The residual claim is only the complete joint nonlinearity-by-resiliency stratification, which was not located in the checked sources.

value.evidence: The complete joint tables are reusable exact benchmark ground truth for two natural finite Boolean-function scopes, beyond isolated extremal values.

checked_sources.title: Rotation symmetric Boolean functions—Count and cryptographic properties
checked_sources.finding: Complete small-n RotS search; explicitly reports eight five-variable 1-resilient degree-3 nonlinearity-12 functions, so that extremal cell is not new.

checked_sources.title: OEIS A004491 / standard bent-function counts
checked_sources.finding: Confirms 896 four-variable bent functions as classical marginal data.

limitations: Full five-variable Boolean space is not enumerated.
Several marginals and extremal cells are classical; originality is only the joint tables relative to checked literature.
